text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gold City was defeated by Tamamo Cross. 
She was forced to realize just how clumsy 
and unrefined her running had truly been 
until now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today, she tasted true frustration for the 
first time. She had been paying so much 
attention to the voices around her that 
she hadn't listened to her own heart.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, she explains that right now, her 
heart simply screams that she wants to 
win, that she wants to run even more.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her run brought tears to her manager's 
eyes. Praising the beauty of seeing her 
truly shine and enjoy herself in the place 
she chose, the manager granted her 
blessing to run.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Next is the Takarazuka Kinen, the final 
leg of the Senior Spring Triple Crown. 
It's time to go show Tamamo Cross who Gold 
City truly is...!
